pages.title: Home
pages.description: Frame the conference, establish urgency, and drive registration.

sections.intent: Announce key dates, early-bird closing, or headline news.
sections.reason: Events teams need at-a-glance awareness of deadlines so they act before it's too late.

sections.intent: Hero summary of the conference value proposition with a register prompt.
sections.reason: A hero anchors the page's core promise and gives the primary CTA the prominence that drives conversion.

sections.intent: Highlight the three pillars: multi-track design, speaker curation, and networking format.
sections.reason: This audience evaluates conferences by structure; listing what the event does well helps them justify the ticket.

sections.intent: Quotes from past attendees about track-switching ease and session quality.
sections.reason: Social proof from peer event teams reduces perceived risk for a multi-track format.

sections.intent: Final registration push with group-rate link.
sections.reason: Footer CTA captures the decision-makers who scrolled to confirm details before committing.

pages.title: Agenda
pages.description: Visual schedule enabling quick track comparison across slots.

sections.intent: Embed an at-a-glance timetable graphic with color-coded tracks.
sections.reason: Events teams need to scan parallel streams fast; a graphical schedule is faster than a list.

sections.intent: Explain the track themes and how to navigate between them.
sections.reason: First-time attendees need context to plan their day, reducing confusion and support inquiries.

pages.title: Speakers
pages.description: Curated speaker lineup with roles and session links.

sections.intent: Showcase two or three keynote speakers with photos and bios.
sections.reason: Headliners are a major draw; featuring them prominently helps sell the conference's caliber.

sections.intent: Grid of all speaker headshots linking to their agenda slots.
sections.reason: A browsable face wall lets attendees quickly spot the experts they want to hear.

pages.title: Venue
pages.description: Practical details about the venue, travel, and stay.

sections.intent: Describe the venue's breakout rooms, stage capacity, and accessibility.
sections.reason: Multi-track events depend on room layout; describing it reassures planners the venue can handle parallel streams.

sections.intent: Address, map, transport tips, and hotel block information.
sections.reason: Logistics are a make-or-break factor for out-of-town attendees; clear contact info reduces drop-off.
